name: skill-ai
description: Personal skill collection for rizalvalry: project-manager (OWNER), planner, developer, solution-architect, bug-hunter, qa-analysis, ai-engineer, game-developer. No-duplication boundaries, split-contract handoffs, and a governance layer that routes work to the owning skill and gates acceptance. Designed for both Claude Code (via /plugin install) and claude.ai (via per-skill ZIP upload). Includes an Opus-pinned `project-manager` orchestrator subagent, an Opus-pinned `planner` subagent, and a Sonnet-pinned `developer` subagent.
